TB is associated with lower quality of life in people with HIV.

the burden of disease in this population is substantial, but not overwhelming.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the burden of disease associated with HIV and active TB is similar to that reported for other chronic diseases, and that the impact of these conditions on QOL is not greater than that of other chronic diseases.
